/-- One local convolution, with one interval and fixed coefficients shared
by every term of the modulus sum.  The residue may move with the atom. -/
structure MediumAtom where
  U : ℝ
  V : ℝ
  Q1 : ℝ
  Q2 : ℝ
  Q3 : ℝ
  residue : ℤ
  intervalLo : ℝ
  intervalHi : ℝ
  alpha : ℕ → ℂ
  beta : ℕ → ℂ
  gamma1 : ℕ → ℂ
  gamma2 : ℕ → ℂ
  gamma3 : ℕ → ℂ

def MediumAtom.scale (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ := d.U * d.V

def MediumAtom.alphaCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil d.U) (Nat.floor (2 * d.U))).filter
    (fun n => d.intervalLo < (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ d.intervalHi)

def MediumAtom.betaCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil d.V) (Nat.floor (2 * d.V))

/-- Concrete dyadic support `Q ≤ q ≤ 2Q`, including the trivial factor
`q=1` at `Q=1`. The manuscript writes `q ≍ Q`; the compiler must assign
overlapping endpoints without multiplicity loss when it chooses its atoms. -/
def factorCarrier (Q : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil Q) (Nat.floor (2 * Q))

/-- Auxiliary-coprimality SW error on the *same* alpha interval. -/
def MediumAtom.auxSWError (d : MediumAtom) (k q b : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier,
    if Nat.ModEq q n b ∧ Nat.Coprime n k then d.alpha n else 0) -
  (∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier,
    if Nat.Coprime n (k * q) then d.alpha n else 0) / (Nat.totient q : ℂ)

/-- Family constants precede the varying atom, interval, auxiliary factor,
modulus and reduced residue.  The divisor order `C0` is fixed once. -/
def UniformAuxiliarySW {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom) (C0 : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧
    ∀ i : ι, x0 ≤ (F i).scale → ∀ k q b : ℕ,
      1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ q → Nat.Coprime b q →
      ‖(F i).auxSWError k q b‖ ≤
        C * (F i).U * ((k.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ C0) /
          (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ A

/-- The literal primitive-coprime mean, without replacing it by total mass. -/
def MediumAtom.discrepancy (d : MediumAtom) (q : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier,
    d.alpha n * d.beta m *
      ((if (((n * m : ℕ) : ℤ) % (q : ℤ) = d.residue % (q : ℤ))
          then (1 : ℂ) else 0) -
        (if Nat.Coprime (n * m) q then (1 : ℂ) else 0) / (Nat.totient q : ℂ))

def MediumAtom.signedError (d : MediumAtom) : ℂ :=
  ∑ q1 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ∑ q2 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2,
    ∑ q3 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
      d.gamma1 q1 * d.gamma2 q2 * d.gamma3 q3 * d.discrepancy (q1 * q2 * q3)

/-- Precisely the geometric and coefficient gates of the frozen restricted
medium proposition.  `scale` is the complete convolution product. -/
def MediumAdmissible (B : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ d.U ∧ 1 ≤ d.V ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q1 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q2 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q3 ∧
  Real.exp (Real.exp 1) < d.scale ∧
  c0 * d.scale ≤ (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + κ) ∧
  d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-σ) ∧
  d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * σ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ^ (7 / 32 : ℝ) * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 ^ 5 * d.Q3 ^ 2 <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  d.U ^ (1 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q1 *
      d.Q2 ^ (5 - 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q3 ^ (2 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ‖d.alpha n‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n ≠ 0 → ∀ p : ℕ,
    Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n →
      d.scale ^ (1 / (Real.log (Real.log d.scale)) ^ 3) < (p : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ≤ (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ B) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ‖d.gamma1 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma1 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ‖d.gamma2 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma2 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ‖d.gamma3 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma3 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs))

/-- Missing uniform signed medium estimate.  This proposition is not proved
by the low-rank BV or one-long integer-slot results in this Part. -/
def RestrictedMediumTarget {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧
    ∀ i : ι, x0 ≤ (F i).scale →
      ‖(F i).signedError‖ ≤ C * (F i).scale / (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ A

/-- Exact unclosed theorem type, including the fixed family SW constants. -/
def RestrictedMediumObligation {ι : Type*} (F : ι → MediumAtom)
    (B C0 : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < σ → σ < 1 / 100 → 0 < c0 → 0 ≤ κ → κ ≤ σ / 100 →
  (∀ i : ι, MediumAdmissible B σ κ c0 (F i)) →
  UniformAuxiliarySW F C0 → RestrictedMediumTarget F

theorem uniformAuxiliarySW_transposedPairedBeta {ι : Type*}
    (F : ι → MediumAtom) (C0 : ℕ) (hSW : UniformAuxiliarySW F C0) :
    ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧
      ∀ i : ι, x0 ≤ (F i).scale → ∀ k q b : ℕ,
        1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ q → Nat.Coprime b q →
        ‖(F i).transposedPairedSWError k q b‖ ≤
          C * (F i).U * ((k.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ C0) / (Real.log (F i).scale) ^ A := by
  simpa only [UniformAuxiliarySW, MediumAtom.transposedPairedSWError_eq_auxSWError] using hSW

/-- The actual divisor square moment of original beta; B stays fixed. -/
theorem mediumAdmissible_beta_norm_sq_sum_le
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    (∑ n ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta n‖ ^ 2) ≤
      2 * d.V * (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ ((2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1) := by
  have hsub : d.betaCarrier ⊆ Finset.Ioc 0 (Nat.floor (2 * d.V)) := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn
    have hceil : 1 ≤ Nat.ceil d.V := by exact_mod_cast hd.2.1.trans (Nat.le_ceil d.V)
    exact Finset.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨by omega, hhi⟩
  apply sum_alpha_sq_le_fouvryTau (k := 2 ^ B)
    (by exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero B (by norm_num)))
    (by linarith [hd.2.1] : 1 ≤ 2 * d.V) d.betaCarrier hsub (fun n ↦ ‖d.beta n‖)
  intro n hn
  have hnpos := (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp (hsub hn)).1
  have hbeta : ‖d.beta n‖ ≤ (n.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ B := by
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hbeta, _⟩ := hd
    exact hbeta n hn
  rw [abs_norm]
  exact hbeta.trans (by
    rw [← fouvryTau_two]
    exact_mod_cast fouvryTau_pow_le 2 B hnpos.ne')

theorem MediumAtom.signedError_norm_sq_le_sharedFirstFactorRows
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    ‖d.signedError‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ^ 2) *
        (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) *
          ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier,
            ‖(d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [d.signedError_eq_sharedFirstFactorRows hd]
  calc
    _ ≤ (∑ z ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ d.betaCarrier,
          ‖d.gamma1 z.1 * d.beta z.2‖ ^ 2) *
        ∑ z ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ d.betaCarrier,
          ‖(d.q1SliceAtom z.1).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow z.2‖ ^ 2 := by
      simpa only [Finset.sum_product] using
        complex_finset_cauchy_norm_sq (d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ d.betaCarrier)
          (fun z ↦ d.gamma1 z.1 * d.beta z.2)
          (fun z ↦ (d.q1SliceAtom z.1).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow z.2)
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_product, norm_mul, mul_pow,
        ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      ring

/-- One original-V cutoff, chosen before the first factor and every row. -/
theorem MediumAtom.signedError_norm_sq_le_sharedFirstFactorSmoothRows
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    ‖d.signedError‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ^ 2) *
        (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) *
          ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
            ∑ m ∈ d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
              d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
                ‖(d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m‖ ^ 2 := by
  apply (d.signedError_norm_sq_le_sharedFirstFactorRows hd).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun p _ ↦ q1Slice_rows_le_commonSmooth d hd.2.1 p)

theorem MediumAtom.sharedFirstFactorSmoothRows_eq_dispersion (d : MediumAtom) :
    (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
      ∑ m ∈ d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
          ‖(d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
        ((d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionW
            d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight -
          2 * (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionV
            d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight +
          (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexDispersionU
            d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight) := by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p _
  exact MediumAtom.complex_dispersion_identity _ _ _

/-- The honest additional Q1 outside cost is explicit. -/
theorem MediumAtom.sharedFirstFactor_outside_le
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    (∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ^ 2) *
      (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) ≤
        4 * d.V * d.Q1 * (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ ((2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1) := by
  have hgamma : (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) ≤ 2 * d.Q1 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, (1 : ℝ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro p hp
        have hh := (SharedFirstFactorDispersion.gamma1_gate hd (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1).1
        simpa only [one_pow] using
          (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg (d.gamma1 p)) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).2 hh
      _ = (d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier.card : ℝ) := by simp
      _ ≤ ((factorCarrier d.Q1).card : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
      _ ≤ _ := SharedFirstFactorDispersion.card_factorCarrier_le hd.2.2.1
  have hbeta := mediumAdmissible_beta_norm_sq_sum_le hd
  have hbetaNonneg : 0 ≤ 2 * d.V *
      (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ ((2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1) :=
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _)).trans hbeta
  calc
    _ ≤ (2 * d.V * (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ ((2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1)) * (2 * d.Q1) :=
      mul_le_mul hbeta hgamma (by positivity) hbetaNonneg
    _ = _ := by ring

def shiftDifference (d : MediumAtom) (v : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((v : ℤ) - d.residue).natAbs

def tau (v : ℕ) : ℝ := (v.divisors.card : ℝ)

def fourthDivisorWeight (d : MediumAtom) (v : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (fouvryTau 4 (shiftDifference d v) : ℝ) ^ 4

def productCarrier (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Ioc 0 (Nat.floor (6 * d.scale))).filter (fun v => (v : ℤ) ≠ d.residue)

/-- The literal actual row, including its signed divisor-deletion gate. -/
def rowSum (d : MediumAtom) (p m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression p m,
    ‖d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n‖ *
      (fouvryTau 4 (shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ) ^ 2

def moment (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  ∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
    ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m * rowSum d p m ^ 2

/-- Every label is (p,m,n), not an unlabelled modulus or a pair quotient. -/
def activeLabels (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) :=
  ((d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier) ×ˢ
      d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier).filter
    (fun z => d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight z.1.2 ≠ 0 ∧
      z.2 ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression z.1.1 z.1.2)

def labelProduct (z : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) : ℕ := z.1.2 * z.2

def foldedSum (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  ∑ v ∈ productCarrier d,
    tau v * tau (shiftDifference d v) * fourthDivisorWeight d v

/-- Original outside energies occur exactly once. -/
def outsideEnergy (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  (∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ^ 2) *
    (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2)

theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_moment_le_finite_divisor_fold
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤ (3 * d.U / d.Q1) *
      CommonPM2FiniteFold.foldedSum d := by
  apply (CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment_le_activeLabels hd hsigma).trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (CommonPM2FiniteFold.sum_activeLabels_le_divisorFold hd hsigma
      (CommonPM2FiniteFold.fourthDivisorWeight d)
      (fun _ => by unfold CommonPM2FiniteFold.fourthDivisorWeight; positivity))
  exact div_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (zero_le_one.trans hd.1))
    (zero_le_one.trans hd.2.2.1)

/-- The literal M2 outside factor is retained exactly once. -/
theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_finite_divisor_fold
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
      CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
        ((3 * d.U / d.Q1) * CommonPM2FiniteFold.foldedSum d) := by
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (d.cleaned_commonP_moment_le_finite_divisor_fold hd hsigma)
  unfold CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy
  exact mul_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))

def MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue then 0 else d.alpha n

def MediumAtom.divisorAlpha (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue then d.alpha n else 0

def MediumAtom.cleanedAlphaAtom (d : MediumAtom) : MediumAtom :=
  { d with alpha := d.cleanedAlpha }

def MediumAtom.divisorAlphaAtom (d : MediumAtom) : MediumAtom :=
  { d with alpha := d.divisorAlpha }

theorem MediumAtom.alpha_eq_clean_add_divisorAlpha (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) :
    d.alpha n = d.cleanedAlpha n + d.divisorAlpha n := by
  by_cases h : (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue <;>
    simp [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, MediumAtom.divisorAlpha, h]

theorem MediumAtom.signedError_eq_clean_add_divisorAlpha (d : MediumAtom) :
    d.signedError = d.cleanedAlphaAtom.signedError + d.divisorAlphaAtom.signedError := by
  conv_lhs =>
    unfold MediumAtom.signedError MediumAtom.discrepancy
    simp only [d.alpha_eq_clean_add_divisorAlpha]
  simp only [MediumAtom.signedError, MediumAtom.discrepancy,
    MediumAtom.cleanedAlphaAtom, MediumAtom.divisorAlphaAtom,
    MediumAtom.alphaCarrier, MediumAtom.betaCarrier,
    mul_add, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

theorem MediumAtom.signedError_sub_cleanAlpha_eq_divisorAlpha (d : MediumAtom) :
    d.signedError - d.cleanedAlphaAtom.signedError = d.divisorAlphaAtom.signedError := by
  rw [d.signedError_eq_clean_add_divisorAlpha]
  ring

theorem mediumAdmissible_cleanedAlphaAtom
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d.cleanedAlphaAtom := by
  obtain ⟨hU, hV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hx, ha0, ha1, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4,
    hAlpha, hRough, hBeta, hGamma1, hGamma2, hGamma3⟩ := hd
  refine ⟨hU, hV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hx, ha0, ha1, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4,
    ?_, ?_, hBeta, hGamma1, hGamma2, hGamma3⟩
  · intro n hn
    change ‖d.cleanedAlpha n‖ ≤ 1
    by_cases h : (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue
    · simp only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_pos h, norm_zero, zero_le_one]
    · simpa only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_neg h] using hAlpha n hn
  · intro n hn hnz p hp hpn
    apply hRough n hn _ p hp hpn
    change d.cleanedAlpha n ≠ 0 at hnz
    by_cases h : (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue
    · exact (hnz (by simp only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_pos h])).elim
    · simpa only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_neg h] using hnz

/-- One threshold precedes every atom and its moving signed residue. -/
theorem signedError_sub_cleanAlpha_log_payment (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 A : ℝ)
    (hsigma : 0 < sigma) (hc0 : 0 < c0) :
    ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧ ∀ d : MediumAtom,
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → x0 ≤ d.scale →
        ‖d.signedError - d.cleanedAlphaAtom.signedError‖ ≤
          d.scale / Real.log d.scale ^ A := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, x1, hx1, hbound⟩ :=
    signedError_sub_cleanAlpha_power_bound B sigma kappa c0 hsigma hc0
  obtain ⟨x2, hx2⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp
    (eventually_const_log_rpow_le_rpow C A hC.le (by linarith : 0 < sigma / 2))
  obtain ⟨x3, hx3⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ))
  refine ⟨max x1 (max x2 x3), hx1.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), fun d hd hx ↦ ?_⟩
  have hscale0 : 0 < d.scale := zero_lt_one.trans_le (one_le_scale hd)
  have hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log d.scale := hx3 d.scale ((le_max_right x2 x3).trans
    ((le_max_right x1 (max x2 x3)).trans hx))
  apply (hbound d hd ((le_max_left _ _).trans hx)).trans
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith : 0 < Real.log d.scale) A)).mpr
  calc
    _ = (C * Real.log d.scale ^ A) * d.scale ^ (1 - sigma / 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ d.scale ^ (sigma / 2) * d.scale ^ (1 - sigma / 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hx2 d.scale ((le_max_left x2 x3).trans
        ((le_max_right x1 (max x2 x3)).trans hx))) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hscale0,
      show sigma / 2 + (1 - sigma / 2) = 1 by ring, Real.rpow_one]

/-- The original beta and primitive gamma1 moments pay the literal same-p
U/V remainder. Its threshold is chosen before every actual medium atom. -/
theorem actual_betaL2_gamma1L2_sharedPrimitiveUV_log_payment
    (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 A : ℝ) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) :
    ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧ ∀ d : MediumAtom,
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → x0 ≤ d.scale →
      (∑ n ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta n‖ ^ 2) *
        (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) *
          ‖d.sharedPrimitiveUVError‖ ≤
            3 * (d.scale ^ 2 / (Real.log d.scale) ^ A) := by

/-- One threshold precedes every original atom and every real paired-gcd
cutoff; both original outside second moments and all three norms are paid. -/
theorem actual_betaL2_gamma1L2_cleaned_sharedLargeSupported_log_payment
    (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 A : ℝ) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) :
    ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧ ∀ d : MediumAtom,
